segments.tha-ap58:1.3: Gantvā kiliṭṭhakaṃ ṭhānaṃ [taṃ bhojanaṭṭhānaṃ (sī.)], mallikāhi parikkhitaṃ [parikkhipiṃ (sī.)].
segments.tha-ap58:3.3: Sammā dhāraṃ pavecchante, phalaṃ toseti kassakaṃ.
segments.tha-ap58:4.3: Bhave nibbattamānamhi, phalaṃ te [nibbattamānaṃ hi, phalato (sī.)] tosayissati [tappayissati (ka.)].
segments.tha-ap58:8.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā saparivārāsano thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.

lines: So evaṃ pattasantipado “kena nu kho puññena idaṃ santipadaṃ anuppattan”ti ñāṇena upadhārento pubbakammaṃ disvā somanassajāto pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento padumuttarabuddhassātiādimāha.
Piṇḍapātaṃ adāsahanti tattha tattha laddhānaṃ piṇḍānaṃ kabaḷaṃ kabaḷaṃ katvā pātabbato khāditabbato āhāro piṇḍapāto, taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhagavato adāsiṃ, bhagavantaṃ bhojesinti attho.
Akittayi piṇḍapātanti mayā dinnapiṇḍapātassa guṇaṃ ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesīti attho.
Saṃvuto pātimokkhasminti pātimokkhasaṃvarasīlena saṃvuto pihito paṭicchannoti attho.
Indriyesu ca pañcasūti cakkhundriyādīsu pañcasu indriyesu rūpādīhi gopito indriyasaṃvarasīlañca gopitoti attho.
